fix.item: Replaced the generic Joomla! event with ContentPrepareEvent for improved event handling.
Replaced calls to $event->getArguments() with individual event method calls.
Updated all XML version references and code blocks to version 1.2.

change.item: Removed the author URL from the manifest file.
Reordered manifest elements to align with the Joomla! plugin tutorial structure.
Updated plugin language strings to remove the “Content Plugin” reference.
Renamed the manifest file to use the full plugin name.
Updated the scriptfile configuration to remove Joomla! 4 references and increase the minimum PHP version.
Clarified the plugin functionality description in language files and the update server definition.
Updated the update server definition to remove Joomla! 4 support and start at Joomla! 5.

note.item: This release modernizes the plugin for Joomla! 5 compatibility.

fix.item: Exit early on nested Dropbox embed tags to prevent duplicate processing.
Strip hyperlinks automatically added by editors from Dropbox embed URLs.

change.item: Changed the release ZIP file name to plg_content_dropboxembed.
Removed database calls that automatically enabled the plugin after installation.

note.item: This maintenance release improves installation behavior and content processing reliability.

add.item: Initial release of the Dropbox Embed content plugin.
Added support for embedding Dropbox content directly into Joomla! articles.
